limitations: Declaration fingerprints compare only the ten named public declaration fields; equality does not prove a complete authoritative mode/condition contract or supplier lifecycle. Examples are retained in this exact projection and do not become executable defaults.
Model comparisons use saved upstream_metadata; application comparisons use their own directly saved API metadata. The model declaration cannot stand in for an application declaration.
Unavailable documents do not prove that a model or API is unavailable. Previously verified document slugs are accepted only after current exact identity checks.
Version2 Token and version3 pixel readiness remain opt-in. No currently blocked real SKU has obtained its missing formal upper bound or receipt contract.
Raw native Token/pixel and Nano pixel consumers retain their separate gates. This batch changes diagnostic output only, not runtime admission or settlement.
No uniform per-tool UI acceptance or real provider generation was performed. Retained historical tasks are not assigned inferred original entry bindings.
